semiconductor_relevance: High — HIGHVAC Corporation provides specialized abatement systems crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes, particularly in Epitaxial and MOCVD GaN applications.
summary: HIGHVAC Corporation is a leading provider of point-of-use abatement systems for the semiconductor industry, focusing on hydrogen-fueled solutions that enhance process efficiency and reduce maintenance. Their EcoGuard systems are designed to manage a variety of hazardous gases and byproducts, ensuring compliance and operational reliability in high-volume manufacturing environments.
capabilities: Turbo molecular and dry vacuum pumps

regional_presence.United States: HIGHVAC is headquartered in Colorado and serves the entire US and Canada.
